source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: بعد عشرين سنة بالغربة، قررت أرجع عالضيعة.
sentences.en: After twenty years abroad, I decided to return to the village.

sentences.ar: كنت خايف إنه كل شي تغير.
sentences.en: I was afraid that everything had changed.

sentences.ar: لما وصلت، لقيت الشوارع نفسها بس أضيق.
sentences.en: When I arrived, I found the same streets but narrower.

sentences.ar: البيوت القديمة لسا واقفة، بس ناسها كبروا.
sentences.en: The old houses were still standing, but their people had aged.

sentences.ar: مشيت بالحارة، وكل خطوة كانت تفكرني بشي.
sentences.en: I walked through the neighborhood, and every step reminded me of something.

sentences.ar: لقيت بيت جدي، وقفت قدامه طويل.
sentences.en: I found my grandfather's house and stood in front of it for a long time.

sentences.ar: الباب كان مسكر، والحديقة صارت يابسة.
sentences.en: The door was closed, and the garden had become dry.

sentences.ar: جار قديم شافني وعرفني رغم السنين.
sentences.en: An old neighbor saw me and recognized me despite the years.

sentences.ar: قال: يا هلا فيك، وينك من زمان؟
sentences.en: He said: welcome back, where have you been all this time?
He invited me to his house, and we sat remembering the old days.

sentences.ar: حكالي مين توفى ومين سافر ومين لسا هون.
sentences.en: He told me who had passed away, who traveled, and who was still here.

sentences.ar: حسيت إنه الزمن مشى، بس الضيعة ضلت بقلبي.
sentences.en: I felt that time had passed, but the village stayed in my heart.

sentences.ar: قبل ما أمشي، قطفت زيتونة من شجرة جدي.
sentences.en: Before I left, I picked an olive from my grandfather's tree.
I put it in my pocket like a treasure.

sentences.ar: عرفت يومها إنه الإنسان بيرجع دايما لجذوره.
sentences.en: That day I learned that a person always returns to their roots.
